metadata.title: That 1 kill where I swear the enemy gave up mid-walk LOL
metadata.description:
I did NOT aim for that but hey, enemy just walked in.
Probably uninstalling to rethink their life right now.
Click if your aim’s broke but the game still hands you freebies!

Tap if your aim’s trash but the game loves you anyway!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
